TITLE: Step 5: Report the evaluation findings
INTRO: Provide any additional information about the evaluation that you want to include in the report. The evaluation findings that you entered in the previous step appear below under “Detailed audit results” to help you review the results and write the executive summary.
INF_TITLE:
Provide a title for the product accessibility evaluation report. For example:
  • “Evaluation Report for Example Organization”
  • “Webshop Accessibility Analysis and Repair Suggestions”
INF_COMMISSIONER: The person, team of people, organization, in-house department, or other entity that commissioned the evaluation.
INF_CREATOR: The person, team of people, organization, in-house department, or other entity responsible for carrying out the evaluation.
INF_DATE:
Provide the completion date or duration dates of this evaluation. You can use any date format. Write out the month to make it clear internationally.
**Note:** The date format 01-02-2022 is ambiguous: it is 2 January in some places and 1 February in other places.
INF_SUMMARY: Provide a brief summary of the evaluation findings to give an overview on the results. For example, describe the overall accessibility of the digital product and key observations you made during the evaluation, such as frequently occurring issues and patterns.
INF_SPECIFICS: WCAG-EM suggests that you archive the samples audited. For more information, see WCAG-EM Step 5.2: Record the evaluation specifics. You can use this text field to record the evaluation tools, web browsers, assistive technologies, other software, and methods used for the evaluation. What you enter here will be included in the generated report. After you download the report, you can delete or edit this information in the HTML file before submitting the report.
